hero.title: Pushkaram College of Agriculture Sciences
hero.summary: Pushkaram College of Agriculture Sciences appears in the audited ICAR agriculture register with a January 2025–January 2030 term. The TNAU 2024–25 prospectus identifies its B.Sc.(Hons.)Agriculture programme and Pudukkottai address. Current admission and campus arrangements require fresh confirmation through the verified TNAU channel.

overview.heading: A Pudukkottai agriculture college near Vamban
paragraphs: The audited ICAR register identifies Pushkaram College of Agriculture Sciences and its undergraduate agriculture accreditation term. TNAU’s 2024–25 prospectus separately lists the college at Veppangudi Village, Thiruvarangulam Post, Alangudi Taluk, Pudukkottai 622303. That dated directory is the address source used here; the different postcode printed in the accreditation record is preserved in its original context.

A current college-controlled website was not verified during this update. Applicants should confirm the intended programme, seat category and institutional contact through TNAU before arranging a visit or paying. No current laboratory, hostel or teaching-farm access is inferred from the old brochure or campus photographs.

faqs.question: Where is Pushkaram College located?
faqs.answer: The TNAU 2024–25 prospectus lists Veppangudi Village, Thiruvarangulam Post, Alangudi Taluk, Pudukkottai 622303.

faqs.question: Why does the audited name show a different postcode?
faqs.answer: The audited ICAR identity includes 322303, while the university prospectus gives 622303. The original audit is preserved and the address discrepancy is flagged for confirmation.

faqs.question: Which source establishes the college address?
faqs.answer: The TNAU 2024–25 prospectus supplies Pushkaram’s Veppangudi, Thiruvarangulam, Alangudi address. It is a dated institutional directory record, not proof of a current admission opening.

faqs.question: Do the photographs establish current practical access?
faqs.answer: No. A college image is not a current timetable or facility-access record. Pushkaram applicants should obtain the department’s actual practical arrangements from the verified admission channel.

faqs.question: What is the verified ICAR period?
faqs.answer: The audited Pushkaram agriculture entry runs from 27 January 2025 to 26 January 2030. This source term does not establish current seats or extend accreditation to a different programme.

faqs.question: Which university is named as the affiliating institution for PCAS?
faqs.answer: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, Coimbatore is the affiliating institution named in this profile.

faqs.question: Where is the official application information for PCAS?
faqs.answer: https://tnau.ucanapply.com/. Read the programme, campus and applicable intake instructions on this official channel.

faqs.question: How can applicants contact PCAS?
faqs.answer: Public telephone: not established; Public email: deanpcas@tnau.ac.in. These are institutional contact details, not an Agrico admissions guarantee.
